quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results (company investor deck): revenue NT$38,143 million, +46.15% QoQ and +197.43% YoY; gross profit NT$16,062 million, gross margin 42.11% (vs 55.69% in Q1 2026 and 18.98% in Q2 2025); operating income NT$12,765 million, operating margin 33.47%; net income NT$10,768 million; profit attributable to owners of parent NT$10,402 million; EPS NT$32.39. The company says revenue, operating income, net income and EPS all hit record highs, with key metrics at record highs for 3 quarters. H1 2026: revenue NT$64.2 billion, operating profit NT$25 billion (+14 times YoY), net income NT$20.7 billion (+13 times YoY), EPS NT$62.46 (highest in company history) - H1 surpassing full-year 2025 (revenue NT$53B, net income NT$7.6B). Q2 revenue by product: DRAM 61%, SSD 32%, memory card & UFD 5%, HDD 1%, others 1%; by region: Asia 52%, Americas 40%, Europe 3%, others 5%. Inventories NT$49,370 million at Q2-end (44% of total assets) vs NT$36,438 million at Q1-end.
